name: XDKNet 2.4.11
body:
Android TV 2.4.11, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.0.9.1 (Emby 2.0.4.1).

This release is about speed. Nothing looks different; it just gets there
sooner and moves more smoothly, especially on Chromecast with Google TV and
other lighter Google TV boxes.

TVs on 2.4.10 offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use Settings > About >
Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once by hand, from the
`XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## Smoother scrolling

**Library grids and home rows keep up with the remote.** Moving focus used to
redraw every card on screen, many times a second while a direction was held.
Only the cards that change are redrawn now.

**Home rows stay put when more items load.** The focused card's title no
longer starts scrolling over again when the next page arrives.

**Long titles scroll without redrawing the whole screen**, and the background
blur is no longer worked out again at the end of every fade.

## Faster loading

- Backdrops and library posters are downloaded at the size they are shown
  rather than two to four times larger. The posters you are looking at load
  before the ones you have scrolled past.
- Opening a movie or series no longer looks through every collection one at a
  time to find the ones it belongs to.
- Continue watching starts loading first, the banner's libraries load
  together, and Seerr and IMDb rows no longer hold up your server's rows.
- The app asks the server for your account and libraries once at startup
  instead of several times, and the codec check no longer holds up the launch.

## Faster playback start

- A movie with a separate subtitle file no longer loads its stream twice
  before it starts.
- With theme music on, the fade-out now happens while the movie loads rather
  than before it.
- The player no longer reads about 20 MB of fonts every time it opens.
- Episodes fetch the one you picked and the next one at the same time.

Emby users: images are downloaded once more after this update, then kept
across sign-ins.

Pair with plugin 2.0.9.1.
